messages:
maria-ops: EDR flagged a suspicious shared object preload on oliver's laptop. quarantine triggered automatically. attaching the EDR snippet below. can someone pick this up?

sec-bot: [AUTOMATED] Alert ID 0xA3F2: SUSPICIOUS_SO_PRELOAD detected. Action: quarantine /tmp/libshim_x7.so, collect process tree, yank network.

maria-ops: EDR log: 
```
PID: 4421 CMD: /home/oliver/workspace/test_runner
ENV: LD_PRELOAD=/tmp/libshim_x7.so
File: /tmp/libshim_x7.so sha256=5f2d9b...c1a
Behavior: ptrace attach, socket connect, write to /etc/ld.so.preload
```

rajiv-sec: Good catch. Confirmed quarantine? If so, get a process memory dump and check for persistence (cron/systemd timers, /etc/ld.so.preload changes). Is the user currently online?

maria-ops: quarantine done by EDR. oliver was remote; he responded and stopped the process. I ran `ls -l /etc/ld.so.preload` — file is absent. no obvious autoruns in crontab.

oliver-dev: Yeah that was my machine. I was iterating on a local shim for instrumentation. I dropped the .so in /tmp and ran. Didn't expect EDR to flag ptrace + preload. I removed the file after quarantine.

rajiv-sec: Ok, benign intent claimed but treat as incident until we verify. Requesting: 1) full EDR scan, 2) memory dump from pid 4421, 3) network egress logs for last 24h, 4) check for any file writes to /etc or ~/.config that coincided.

james-sre: Running full scan now: `sudo edrctl scan --full --user oliver` and `sudo edrctl collect --pid 4421 --memdump /opt/forensics/oliver-4421.dmp`. forwarding to sec bucket.

lena-it: Did the user pull artifacts from an external S3 bucket or package repo? we need to know origin. Also, any KMS activity for keys used to decrypt artifacts on that host?

maria-ops: Download history: `~/.cache/pip` shows recent wheel from internal artifactory. No S3 GETs in local webproxy logs for oliver's IP.

rajiv-sec: I'll check cloud KMS audit logs for any CMK decrypts or sign operations tied to oliver's principal. Give me 15m.

sec-bot: [AUDIT] KMS request log query executed by rajiv-sec: no decrypt/sign events for principal `u:oliver@redwood` in the timeframe.

rajiv-sec: Confirmed. No KMS key usage. Looks like local test binary — still need to confirm nothing exfiltrated. Pulling network flows to check remote IPs contacted by PID 4421.

james-sre: Network capture: PID 4421 connected to 54.149.22.77:443 at 12:03 UTC. Reverse DNS points to third-party CI runner IP block. Could be dependency fetch.

oliver-dev: That IP is where our internal CI mirrors third-party images. I grabbed the .so from a local build output earlier, not from that host.

rajiv-sec: Still want to be safe. Next steps: 1) reimage dev VM or reprovision laptop image for oliver, 2) rotate any local service credentials that may have been present on the host, 3) add an audit rule to detect `LD_PRELOAD` environment in long-running processes.

maria-ops: Agreed. I created a Jira ticket INFSEC-7321 to track reimage and follow-up. Please add remediation tasks.

james-sre: Adding: `auditd` rule suggestion — monitor execve with env var LD_PRELOAD: `-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S execve -F uid>=1000 -F key=ldpreload` (we'll filter on env after collection). Also adding a YARA rule to detect known shim patterns.

rajiv-sec: For immediate containment, we should block outbound egress to that CI IP range for oliver's machine until reprovisioned. Also revoke any user-scoped tokens cached in `~/.netrc`/credential helpers.

lena-it: I rotated the service account token tied to oliver's local tooling and forced reissue. Logged rotation in payroll-kms-access log (ticket linked).

oliver-dev: I can repro my work in an ephemeral container moving forward. sorry for the noise — lesson learned.

maria-ops: Post-incident: schedule a 1:1 with oliver for secure dev practices, add short doc to devex about safe LD_PRELOAD testing, and ensure audit log entry for this incident is persisted in our compliance bucket.

rajiv-sec: Closing timeline: initial alert 1917543210, containment/quarantine done 1917543345, scans & dumps collected 1917543920, reimage scheduled 1917544200. Marking incident as "investigating" until reimage completes.

sec-bot: [ACTION] Linked INFSEC-7321 to compliance retention policy. Reminder: attach memdump and edr logs to the ticket. :lock:
